population: the first eight SOURCE_REQUIRED assets in queue order
populationCaveat: The batch instruction says to take the first eight retained assets assigned to terminal treatment rather than must_packet. The string must_packet does not appear anywhere in this repository, and the assignment base classifies the 81 queued assets only as SOURCE_REQUIRED (37), RERENDER_REQUIRED (39) and RETIRE_OR_REPOINT (5). No terminal-versus-must_packet split has been published, so the source-blocked bucket named in this batch's own title was used and the substitution is recorded here rather than assumed.
headlineFinding: The participant-facing terminalization layer is already complete. terminalization-evidence-briefs.json carries 114 briefs and data/rcap-all50/terminalization-treatments/ carries 114 treatments: briefed tracks with no treatment = 0, treated tracks with no brief = 0. None of the eight assets in this batch is a participant route, none carries a legal-design or packet-family reference, and none has an untreated track to attach to. There is no terminal treatment left to write for them, and writing one would duplicate complete coverage while inventing facts the briefs do not carry.
prohibitionsHonoured: no checkout or packet generation enabled
no generic coming-soon language introduced anywhere

session13Handoff.population: all eight assets in this batch
session13Handoff.why: Each asset retains at least one operational-manifest dependency, and the standing boundary forbids retiring an asset with a surviving runtime, packet-family, legal-design, route, compiled-profile or operational-manifest dependency. All eight retain application_source; five also retain overlay_factory_manifest.
session13Handoff.repointWorkRequired: For each asset, either drop the application_source reference and, where present, the overlay_factory_manifest entry, or repoint both to the canonical asset. Once no operational reference survives, the asset is retirable without touching any participant route, because none depends on it.
session13Handoff.whatMakesThisSafe: Zero legalDesignReferences and zero packetFamilyReferences across all eight, so retirement or repoint cannot strand a participant route. Confirmed against the queue rows at the assignment base.
